# Khoa Auto Repair

> Import & everyday auto repair based in Pflugerville, Texas. Khoa Auto Repair is the Pflugerville shop people find by word of mouth. Mr. Ly and Mr. Toan diagnose it right the first time, text you updates, and charge fairly.

- Phone: (512) 573-4142

- Service area: Pflugerville, Austin, Wells Branch, Round Rock, Hutto

## Services
- Diagnosis done right: The real cause found first, even when other shops guessed wrong.
- Brakes: Rotors and pads on both axles, done quickly and cleanly.
- Engine & cooling: Water pumps, ignition coils, plugs and coolant service.
- Starting & electrical: No-starts, starters and lighting repairs.
- Scheduled maintenance: Oil changes and the maintenance your dash keeps reminding you about.

## About
Khoa Auto Repair is run by Mr. Ly, with Mr. Toan in the bays. Most customers heard about it from a friend or neighbor and stayed for years. Reviewers mention getting a text when the car is ready, same-day fixes for check-engine lights, and correct diagnoses after a chain shop got it wrong.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you work on Lexus and Toyota?
  A: Yes. Many regulars bring Camrys, RX 350s and other Toyota and Lexus models.
- Q: Can I text the shop?
  A: Reviewers say they text Khoa for updates and scheduling.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Call or book online; the shop works by appointment so it can give each car proper time.
